ios.desc:
Bunch is now Mini Party! Talk and play games with friends—on any screen.

Mini Party makes it easy to hang out, chat, and play games with friends, whether you’re on your phone or laptop. No need for everyone to install the app—just jump in and start playing.

What You Can Do:
	•	Challenge friends in 3D party games, draw together, play cards, shoot pool, throw hoops, and more. New games are added every month.
	•	Play Anywhere – Works on mobile and desktop, so you can join from wherever you are.
	•	See Who’s Around – Get notified when friends are online and hop into a game right away.
	•	Bump to Play – Connect with friends nearby and start playing instantly.
	•	No Installs Needed – Your friends can join without downloading anything.
	•	Meet New People – Join public parties and play with others.

No setup, no hassle—just games and good times. Download Mini Party and start playing!

quotes.text:
Gonna try it out! Looks fun :)

I'm curious, you use react-native-navigation. Did you ever try react-navigation? That's what we are currently using. Don't have any strong complaints, but know it does everything in JS. Was wondering if maybe you tried both and have any comments.

BTW, here is our RN app. https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/bunch-group-video-chat-games/id1294869021?mt=8

I (we) also love RN (most of the time :P ).

Awesome, thanks for posting this! Been hearing/reading some of the claims that FB is done supporting RN and it got me spooked :p

We've been working on a RN project [1] for the list 6 months or so. Although it's been a bumpy ride - overall I have loved it. RN mixed with Firebase has been an awesome experience.

[1]: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/bunch-group-video-chat-games/id1294869021?mt=8

Ya, we love Firebase! Use Firebase functions heavily and i've been very pleased. That tied with redux works so smoothly. It's a different way of thinking about things but I find it so much easier to maintain and reason about than your conventional rest service.

Couple things I wish it had:

1. Ability to `keepalive` certain functions. Cold start is real. We have gotten around this via app engine cron that triggers certain functions.

2. Schedule them on cron. We have gotten around this using app engine.

If curious, this is what we are building off of Firebase (and React native) https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/bunch-group-video-chat-games/id1294869021?mt=8
